functional_gates: Each delta-spec scenario maps to an observed result
Full real-HA configurations equal after save/reload/reopen; untouched fields preserved
One intent per activation, zero body intents for inner actions; no forwarded call_service
Invalid/missing/unknown/unavailable states isolated; recovery replays no action
Zero unrelated slot DOM mutations; only dependent relevant content changes
Owned listeners/subscriptions/scheduled work return to zero after removal
No overlap, unintended overflow or clipping; reachable controls, visible focus and names
